title: Mehendi Raat Housie: soch vs sach
format: Kitty Gang expectation vs reality at the theme's Housie

experiment.hook: banner 'Mehendi Raat Housie: soch vs sach' over 3 dressed-up gang faces on the Mehendi Raat home art, reactions flying, chip SOCH
experiment.variable: a two-part contrast (pretty plan, then messy reality) built on one physical gag everyone knows: wet mehendi hands that cannot tap the phone
experiment.hypothesis: an instantly recognisable mehendi problem hooks harder than a rivalry: skip under 55%, watched % above 25, at least 2 shares

idea: The gang dresses up for Mehendi Raat Housie, but with wet mehendi nobody can tap the ticket, and the one friend who skipped the mehendi wins Full House.
beats: hook: soch vs sach banner / soch: Zoya's mehendi photo, Tanya's dress code / sach: Myra can't tap with wet mehendi / esc: nose tap, elbow for Kangan, mehendi on the screen / turn: Aditi gets Full House / button: Aditi will get mehendi after Housie
caption: {theme} Housie pe aap kaun ho: mehendi pehle ya Housie pehle? Comment karo aur mehendi wali saheli ko tag karo!

lines.text: Mehendi geeli hai! Tap kaise karun?
lines.say: मेहंदी गीली है! टैप कैसे करूँ?

lines.text: Ruko, naak se tap karti hoon.
lines.say: रुको, नाक से टैप करती हूँ।

lines.text: Kohni se dabao! Kangan line hai!
lines.say: कोहनी से दबाओ! कंगन लाइन है!

lines.text: Ab mehendi screen pe lag gayi!
Housie ke baad. Har saal yahi.
lines.say: हाउज़ी के बाद। हर साल यही।
